content_sections.heading: AN Administration District Consultant (DM) Job Description
content_sections.text: The District Consultant (DM) shall report to appropriate authority in the district and shall maintain coordination with UTDMA. Alignment of District plans in accordance with the provisions of the Disaster Management Act., Sendai Framework and State Plan. Coordination of Mock Exercise at Various locations in the districts. Training of Officials for capacity building for better preparedness and effective response measures. Creation of Awareness about Disaster Risk Management. Compiling and timely furnishing of data and information to UTDMA on disaster aspects and Sendai Framework monitoring indicators. Improve coordination of the District Administration with Circle level and Panchayat level for effective preparedness, response and mitigation measures. Help in setting up of the Disaster Data Base at District Level. Assist the DDMA in identifying opportunities for mainstreaming Disaster Risk Reduction (DRR) development programmes. Any other task assigned by UTDMA/DDMA.

content_sections.heading: Enclosures
content_sections.text: Duly filled application or Curriculum Vitae (CV) in the prescribed format. Self-attested copies as proof of details furnished in the application/resume. 02 recent passport size photos duly self-attested.

content_sections.heading: Selection Process
content_sections.text: Candidates will be selected through Walk-in-Interview. The date and venue of interview will be published in the website www.ddm.and.nic.in, The Daily Telegrams and announced through All India Radio, Port Blair. No individual call letters will be sent to the candidates. Candidates must bring their original certificates for verification on the day of personal interview. No TA or DA will be paid to the candidates for attending the selection process or personal interview.

faq.question: Q1. How many vacancies are announced for the District Consultant (DM) post?
faq.answer: There are 02 total vacancies available for the District Consultant (DM) post under the Andaman & Nicobar Administration.

faq.question: Q3. What is the educational qualification required for the District Consultant post?
faq.answer: Candidates must possess a Master Degree in Disaster Management or Master Degree with PG Diploma in Disaster Management, along with a minimum of 02 years experience in the field of Disaster Management.
